host: Codex CLI project AGENTS.md, on-demand offline recall
scope: one Hermes operational workspace; no global hook or skill contract change
baseline: Existing miner misses a private clarification episode; existing keyword recall returns domain-word false positives. Private evidence is retained outside Git.
fail_open: Failure returns bounded empty evidence with success exit status, leaves prompt and host result unchanged, and never executes recalled data.
holdout: Independent evaluator authors and freezes labels without reading implementation or private evidence; candidate source identity frozen before execution. Seed and development cases never count as holdout.
installation: Only after acceptance and independent review; preserve exact prior configuration and verify rollback before re-enabling.
